_about: The words shown with each real app step: at most eight, no figures, and only what the step's screen shows. Written by the director from each step's own tutorial line; a reel's app scene, a carousel's screen slide and the writer's catalogue all use these, so no post can claim more than the screen. Key: <page>#<step>; <recording>#<step> overrides it where phone and desktop differ.
